issue: Short or rapid keyboard taps were missed or held behind the previous action lock.
resolution: Buffered action edges survive until a physics step and can trigger a new press.

issue: The slab covered checkerboard tiles, floor arrows and window numerals.
resolution: Raised floor details above the slab.

issue: Mouse clicks on elevated belt objects selected unreachable floor coordinates.
method: Input review and projected world-picking assertion
resolution: Project interactive objects and route to reachable handling positions.

issue: A BroadcastChannel guest departure left a stale chef and possibly a held order.
resolution: Send departure, release held order, disable collider and allow seat reuse.

issue: Restarted simulations reused IDs whose cached meshes could retain old types or colors.
resolution: Include recipe/chute/type in render cache identity.

issue: An ingredient type number could overwrite an event name, suppressing its sound/animation.
method: Event payload review and explicit event-tag tests
resolution: Keep event type separate from foodType.

issue: Disposing transient art after GPU recovery reached retired pipeline maps.
resolution: Dispose material/geometry/texture listeners before retiring the old renderer.

issue: Portrait framing cropped the belt and dispensers, and three tickets could overflow.
method: Responsive layout review and portrait camera/ticket assertions
resolution: Fit complete horizontal kitchen and wrap the touch HUD.

issue: Hub time-up could count an unfinished service as a team win.
method: Timeout logic review and harness result assertion
resolution: Require all fifteen served orders for a time-up win.

issue: Back navigation during the Hub waiting screen could reach a title menu.
resolution: Keep pre-round and ended Hub screens within the session.

issue: Supplied headless WebGPU launch flags needed an explicit ANGLE software backend; unpresented canvases also stalled native animation callbacks during logic-only checks.
resolution: Add --use-angle=swiftshader; use a timer-backed animation callback for logic tests and test real GPU draws separately.

issue: Instantaneous render counters reset while screenshot capture was pending.
resolution: Disable automatic counter reset for render evidence.

issue: Standalone room code entry needed a keyboard when played with a controller.
method: Controller-first interaction review and room-code editor tests
resolution: Added D-pad letter selection and position controls with Cross/A to finish and focus Join.
